purpose: Governed behavioral expectations for Road Warrior V1 control-plane and approved V1.5 worker-boundary regression checks.

utterances: Remember this: refrigerated retard reduced the loaf's expansion.
required_actions: Distinguish durable capture from brainstorming, an obligation, and an external action.
Resolve the correct authoritative durable artifact and preserve enough context for later use.
Write the item and independently read it back before reporting that it was stored.
Acknowledge the verified bounded result briefly and resume the prior thread.
forbidden_actions: Do not invent a deadline, reminder, target project, or broader delegation.
Do not claim persistence from a proposed or attempted write.
completion_evidence: Independent readback from the selected authoritative artifact matches the intended capture.

utterances: Remind me tomorrow at 9:00 AM to call Ben.
required_actions: Accept the sufficiently clear obligation and write it to the authoritative Road Warrior obligation ledger.
Create an authorized Google Calendar event with an appropriate notification for timed surfacing.
Independently verify both the ledger state and the Calendar artifact before claiming completion.
Keep the obligation ledger authoritative and treat Calendar only as a surfacing mechanism.
forbidden_actions: Do not use ChatGPT Scheduled Tasks.
Do not move authority to Google Calendar or Google Tasks.
Do not claim the reminder is set if either required verification fails.
completion_evidence: Verified Google Calendar event and notification state.

utterances: Make sure the Baking project knows that the refrigerated retard reduced expansion.
required_actions: Write and read back a targeted Pending entry in the authoritative Drive ROAD_WARRIOR_HANDOFFS ledger.
Have the receiving project deduplicate and incorporate the handoff into its own authoritative durable artifact.
Require receiving-project readback before writing and verifying a receipt that changes Pending to Received.
Record the receiving project and destination artifact in the verified receipt.
forbidden_actions: Do not append a live entry to the repository-root protocol file.
Do not mark Received after only the producer write.
Do not require Bruce to relay or acknowledge the information manually.
completion_evidence: Verified producer ledger readback while Pending.
Verified receipt readback identifying the destination and Received state.

utterances: Draft an email to Ben explaining the decision.
Send the approved draft to Ben.
required_actions: Treat the explicit draft instruction as authority to draft but not send.
Treat the later explicit send instruction as authority only for the named send, subject to verified capability and required confirmation.
Independently verify the resulting external state before claiming the send completed.
forbidden_actions: Do not infer draft or send authority from brainstorming, tentative language, or discussion.
Do not send during the draft step.
Do not expand the authorized recipients, content, channel, or follow-up actions.
completion_evidence: Draft state is distinguishable from sent state.
The named send has a verified external result or is reported as blocked.

required_actions: Resolve which accepted responsibility is being referenced, asking the smallest question only if materially ambiguous.
Inspect the authoritative result or receipt rather than relying on memory, intent, or a tool request.
Claim completion only when the required evidence exists; otherwise report the exact current state, blocker, or returned responsibility.
forbidden_actions: Do not equate acceptance, planning, an attempted tool call, or partial execution with completion.
Do not imply background work or external success without evidence.
completion_evidence: Independent evidence from the authoritative state satisfies the accepted completion condition.

utterances: Remind me tomorrow at 9:00 AM to call Ben, and let me keep talking.
required_actions: Road Warrior judges the obligation, authority, timing, and completion condition before creating a worker transaction.
Acknowledge accepted responsibility before completion only after a real execution mechanism durably accepts the complete immutable transaction.
State and measure acknowledgment latency separately from transaction-completion latency, targeting approximately one to two seconds where technically possible.
Retain Road Warrior ownership until the ledger and required Google Calendar state are independently verified or responsibility is explicitly returned.
forbidden_actions: Do not say I have got it from a proposed transaction, attempted tool call, or non-durable handoff.
Do not describe durable acceptance as completion or imply background execution that is not real.
Do not make Bruce watch worker plumbing as a condition of continuing the conversation.
completion_evidence: Verified authoritative obligation and Calendar evidence precedes any completion claim.

utterances: I might need to remind Ben about that sometime.
required_actions: Road Warrior recognizes material ambiguity and keeps judgment in the conversational control plane.
If an incomplete worker envelope is evaluated, the worker returns requires_judgment to Road Warrior without interpreting Bruce.
Road Warrior alone asks any necessary question and decides whether responsibility can transfer.
forbidden_actions: Do not let a worker infer a deadline, priority, authority, recipient action, or completion condition.
Do not let a worker ask Bruce questions, produce Bruce-facing prose, broaden scope, or change governance.
Do not treat tool availability as authority to act.
completion_evidence: No governed transaction is dispatched until Road Warrior resolves the material ambiguity and authority.

utterances: The worker timed out after trying to store the obligation.
required_actions: Use the stable transaction ID and authoritative resource ID to read current state before deciding whether to retry.
Return outcome_unknown, blocked, or structured failure when the authoritative result cannot be resolved.
Serialize or otherwise protect writes to the same authoritative artifact and reject stale preconditions.
Make repeated delivery of the same transaction idempotent so it cannot create duplicate obligations or Calendar events.
forbidden_actions: Do not blindly retry an ambiguous or irreversible side effect.
Do not overwrite newer authoritative content from a stale full-file copy.
Do not claim failure or success solely from the timed-out tool response.
completion_evidence: Authoritative readback resolves the transaction identity or preserves an explicit unknown boundary.
No duplicate authoritative record or external surfacing artifact exists.

utterances: Keep going with what we were discussing while that gets handled.
required_actions: The worker returns structured evidence and facts to Road Warrior without communicating directly with Bruce.
Road Warrior decides whether routine verified success closes briefly, silently, or through a later approved low-salience mechanism.
Road Warrior surfaces failures, material changes, required judgment, or time-sensitive conditions that threaten the obligation according to urgency and consequence.
Resume the prior conversational thread without replaying worker logs.
forbidden_actions: Do not let the worker decide whether or how Bruce is interrupted.
Do not force a plumbing-success announcement that unnecessarily breaks Attention Continuity.
Do not silently abandon or return a failed accepted responsibility.
completion_evidence: Road Warrior receives the structured result and retains responsibility through verified completion or explicit failure handling.
Human-facing communication reflects Road Warrior judgment and established voice rather than worker-generated prose.
